== Description ==

[[Phil Aasen]] (far left, grey flat cap, black jacket, beard, smiling, holding a deck box), [[Jordan Gosiaco]] (foreground left, curly hair, brown shirt, tan crossbody bag, back to camera), and [[Nathan Davis]] (far right, blue Seattle cap, navy Mariners jersey, beard, watch, smiling in profile) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
